[SWS_CM_10447] Dealing with unmodelled
ApApplicationError
s
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213, RS_SOMEIP_00007
⌈
If the service method (see [SWS_CM_00191]) returns an
ApApplicationError
different from the modeled ones (i.e., different from the ones referenced by the
ClientServerOperation
in role
possibleApError
or in role
possibleApEr-
rorSet
.
apApplicationError
),treating this as a violation according to [SWS_-
CORE_00003]. No message shall be sent back to the client.
⌋
